forecast: Climax down-bar just tagged 4001 support on 30x volume and closed +12 off the low (4013.5) with RSI 10.5 / 5m RSI 4.5 - a short-term exhaustion print. Expect a relief bounce toward 4025-4040 (VWAP/broken level) over the next 2-4 bars, or a flush through 4001 if sellers reload; neither is a clean high-expectancy entry ahead of CPI.
expectancy_note: No trade: chasing short into RSI ~10 at support is the book's classic loser (bounce hits the stop); a long needs a 4025 reclaim, not a knife-catch, especially with binary CPI tomorrow.
rationale: XAUT is deeply extended DOWN - RSI 10.5, %B -0.26, price 1.5% below VWAP, and the last 15m bar plunged to the exact 4001 support then recovered $12 on 30x volume, an exhaustion signature that makes a fresh short a low-quality chase (the account keeps dying shorting stretched tape into the bounce). A long is equally premature: macro has the dollar, not gold, as the haven and CPI Tuesday is a two-sided binary, so buying a knife below reclaimed structure has poor odds. Flat is the highest-expectancy call; I want either a reclaim of 4025 (broken breakout level -> bounce confirmed) or a clean break/hold below 4001 to define the next move.

reconsider.note: Reclaiming the 4025.6 broken-breakout level confirms the 4001 exhaustion bounce and opens a long toward 4040-4060; below 4001 instead resumes the downtrend.
